text: Team 1 — Foundation Layer
You build the shared foundation everyone else depends on: data.c, data.h, display.c, and display.h. Without your files, Team 2 and Team 3 cannot compile or run menus.
Your deliverable: 4 files that hold ALL product/dealer/retailer data and ALL screen printing (menus, tables, password).
1. What You Are Building
1.1 data.h — The data contract
Defines limits (MAX_PRODUCTS, MAX_DEALERS, MAX_RETAILERS) and declares every shared array with extern. Other teams include this file to read stock and names.
1.2 data.c — The real database

Defines the actual arrays in memory and init_data() to load sample Rice/Oil/Sugar, two dealers, two retailers, and all starting stock. Also provides show_company_products() and show_dealer_products() for ordering screens.
1.3 display.h + display.c — Shared UI
Every menu box, table row, success/error message, password check, and order summary. Team 2 and 3 never draw tables themselves — they call your functions.
2. Build Order (Do This Sequence)
Create data.h — constants and extern declarations only.
Create data.c — arrays + init_data() with sample data.
Create display.h — list every print function.
Create display.c — implement prints + verify_password().
Test with a tiny test_main.c (optional) or wait for Team 2's main.c.
Finish data.h before Team 2/3 start their .c files — they need your extern names and MAX_* values.
3. Step-by-Step: data.h
Start empty. Add one section at a time.
Step 3.1 — Limits

#define MAX_PRODUCTS 10
#define MAX_DEALERS 5
#define MAX_RETAILERS 5
Step 3.2 — Product arrays (extern)
Step 3.3 — Dealer arrays
Step 3.4 — Retailer arrays
Step 3.5 — Function declarations
4. Step-by-Step: data.c
Step 4.1 — Includes and array definitions
Step 4.2 — init_data() products
Step 4.3 — init_data() dealers + stock grid
Step 4.4 — init_data() retailers
Step 4.5 — show_company_products()
Loop with for, call display helpers:
Step 4.6 — show_dealer_products(dealer_index)
5. Step-by-Step: display.h and display.c
display.h — declare all helpers
display.c — password (Team 2 & 3 need this)
Table row — core pattern
6. Test Your Part Alone
Before Team 2 delivers main.c, compile only your files with a minimal test:

gcc test_team1.c data.c display.c -o test1
./test1
Expected: product table with Rice/Oil/Sugar, then password prompt. Type 1122 → SUCCESS.
